blocks.text: PARIS, France — More than 400 people, most of them minors, were detained in France Tuesday over blockades and protests at high schools across the country, the interior minister said. Since last week, students have staged protests outside hundreds of schools over grievances including timetables, class sizes and a shortage of teachers as well as overheated classrooms during this year’s heatwaves.
